one_liner: Offline apartment/house viewing decision assistant: room-by-room scorecards with photo evidence, weighted side-by-side comparison, verdict
target_user: renters and buyers visiting multiple properties before deciding
core_job: compare apartment viewings with weighted scorecard to choose
primary_interaction: score rooms during the visit -> weighted ranking across viewings -> pick a winner
wedge_hypothesis: people rely on memory and scattered photos; existing apps are realtor CRMs or generic checklists, not decision compare
